$comment: Copy to .shawshank/config.json in the project's common checkout only if absent. Adapt project settings and worker roles; machine- and person-specific values belong in .shawshank/config.local.json (see the sibling config.local.example.json). Templates are not loaded directly.

roles.$comment: All workers use external Herdr panes. Every role needs kind, model and args. Args are passed verbatim to the worker CLI; metadata does not inject flags. Adapt model and permission flags to the installed CLI and existing authorization. Provider identifies the configured endpoint; do not infer it solely from the harness.

taskReviewer.$comment: Independent external single-task reviewer for shawshank. Auto evaluates permissions; it does not bypass them.

hard.$comment: Alternative verifier selected explicitly for harder repairs.

implementer.$comment: One example per tier; all tiers may use the same model. Choose cheap for mechanical work, standard for integration, capable for design-heavy work. Optional additional entries require explicit selection, not automatic fallback. See references/task-contract.md for repair escalation.
